msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia maribel-calzados-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a tall camel suede boot with a block heel, held up against a shop wall from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia maribel-calzados-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of two tall leather riding boots, one brown and one black (still life) from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia maribel-calzados-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of a taupe suede ankle boot with long fringe and gold studs from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia maribel-calzados-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of burgundy and navy suede heeled ankle boots from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia maribel-calzados-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of taupe leather comfort sneaker shoes with velcro straps from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail.
